response.sql: WITH scope_averages AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope), mean_of_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS overall_mean FROM scope_averages) SELECT sa.acctscope AS scope, sa.avg_net_fee_rate, sa.count, sa.avg_net_fee_rate - ma.overall_mean AS distance_from_mean FROM scope_averages sa CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma
